steps: PNR form not found via entry links; update entry_link_text / pnr_input in config

followup_2026_10_18.how_verified: hrefs of the site's own Trips menu (Edit Booking, Find & view booking)
followup_2026_10_18.observation: In automation-launched Chromium (headed, fresh profile) the HTML loads with HTTP 200, but the CDN fails the site's own JS/CSS/font bundles with net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR (/etc.clientlibs/skyplus6ev2/clientlibs/clientlib-site.min.js etc.), so the PNR form never renders. A reused (persistent) profile was refused at the HTML level.
followup_2026_10_18.decision: No stealth/fingerprint evasion. Live bookings use assisted capture: the user retrieves their own booking in their normal Chrome; the agent attaches over CDP and only reads booking JSON responses.
